label: PF Backlog 464
title: RCCA + guard: commit-branch assertion (never commit feature work directly on develop/main)
body:
Source: process deviation during BI-PF-0428 (2026-10-07), self-detected.

WHAT HAPPENED: BI-PF-0428 was committed DIRECTLY on `develop` (commit a48f851) instead of a feature branch -
violating AGENTS "never commit to develop/main directly". Caught immediately; remediated without touching the
~398 unrelated dirty WIP files: created `feature/delivery-runner` at the commit, `git reset --mixed` develop
back, reverted only the 2 touched files, then `git merge --no-ff` -> develop now carries a merge commit
(8dfd400). Correct delivery recorded on BI-PF-0428.

RCCA (5-Why):
1. develop had a direct commit. 2. I committed without switching to a feature branch.
3. The 0428 work reused the leftover 0427 branch context in my head; I never ran `git checkout -b`.
4. The pre-commit path has no BRANCH assertion (only store-check + lint), so committing on develop was not
   blocked. 5. Guard: a pre-commit/commit-time check that refuses to commit when HEAD is the integration branch
   (develop/main) for a non-bookkeeping change - or at minimum a documented assertion to run before committing.

FIX (proposed, not a shortcut): add a branch guard (git hook OR a check in the dev flow / AGENTS working
agreement): before committing feature work, assert `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD` is not develop/main.
